summaries.summary: The Supreme Court of India has issued notices regarding a petition by opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi, related to voter irregularities during a protest march. The court emphasized the independence of the judiciary in response to the situation.

Apple has collaborated with Schneider to produce a new smart thermostat aimed at helping users reduce their electric bills. Additionally, features related to smart home devices from Apple, including a new home display hub, are also in focus.

A tragic incident in Pakistan has resulted in the deaths of over 30 children due to a school roof collapse, leading to the arrest of the school's owner. This incident has raised significant concerns about safety regulations.

Discussions regarding a US-India trade deal are progressing, with completion of the first tranche expected soon. Both countries aim to operationalize the agreement, focusing on creating competitive advantages for India.

YouTube has introduced new labeling for AI-generated music across its platforms, responding to demands for transparency among listeners about the origins of songs. This move is part of a broader trend in the music industry to address the rise of AI-generated content.

A 19-year-old from Illinois has been arrested for allegedly planning an attack on a Hindu place of worship. This incident is part of ongoing concerns regarding hate crimes and violence against specific communities in the U.S.
Figma announced new features to enhance the functionality of its design platform, including updates that define agent roles and a beta release for new code layers.
Ricursive Intelligence is focusing on AI-designed chips to tackle the compute crisis, seeking to automate and improve the chip design process.
Citizen Lab has reported that governments are using online advertisements to deploy spyware on individuals' devices, highlighting serious concerns about privacy and security.
